How the rating works

FPL Rating

Goes up and down after every round. Beating a strong work earns more than beating a weak one.

League

Set by your rating before the Game starts and stays the same until it ends. League thresholds are fixed for the whole season.

Calibration

A newcomer needs three results for the rating to become accurate. Until then it is marked as provisional.

FPL Points

Separate from the rating: earned for taking part and for awards, and they never expire.
